#: PanProbe driver env A/B (Firebase game-loop scenario 3, EnvPasses.kt). Doc: worklogs/g615-dxvk/panplay-firebase-cubes.md. One Run all per pass, in order, rc5 driver. env: PANVK_* / MESA_* / PAN_* keys only, into every test process. Optional per pass: "tests": "name1,name2" (default all). Scenarios 1 and 2 never read this file.

passes.name: 114-knobs
passes.#env: every default-on 115 perf knob of staging-115 pa (8), pb (8), pc (5) and pd (5; JM only, ignored on CSF) at its 114 value (NOTES.md of each package; the pa-pc 21 are the PanPlay gameloop.json 'old' set). pd 0007 (JM TLS/WLS no-clear) is restored by PANVK_KBASE_ZERO_ALL=1 (pb). Opt-in knobs (PANVK_KBASE_COHERENT_POOLS, PANVK_KBASE_EVICTABLE, PANVK_KBASE_HEAP_SLOTS) stay unset. PANVK_ZS_PRELOAD_ALWAYS is left out: on v11 its 114 value is the unset default (csf-v11 061); add PANVK_ZS_PRELOAD_ALWAYS=1 on v9/v10. A subset bisects (override file /data/local/tmp/panprobe-env-ab.json).
